title: Each thread gets its own number
summary: Do not pass &i of the loop variable: give every thread its own argument.
hints: Keep an array `int ids[8]` and pass `&ids[i]`: every thread has its own slot. `&i` is shared by all and changes while the loop runs.
Each thread writes `i * i` into `results[i]` (a global array); the main thread prints after joining ALL the threads.
